_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "I want to report my extremely disappointing experiences with Etsy. 1. I purchased a "Winter" set including hand gloves, a scarf, and a hat, which was advertised as cashmere but was not. I had to return it. 2. I also purchased items with "sapphire" glass stones sold as genuine sapphires, which they clearly were not. Etsy allows sellers to mislead buyers and ignores legitimate complaints. Because of this, I have closed my account and will no longer shop on Etsy."
